title: Identity vs state, live
prompt:
1. `static boolean smallBoxedIdentity()` — `Integer a = 100, b = 100; return a == b;`
2. `static boolean largeBoxedIdentity()` — `Integer a = 500, b = 500; return a == b;`
3. `static boolean largeBoxedEquals()` — same values, `a.equals(b)`.
4. `static int sameIdentityTwice()` — build one `List<String>`, call
`System.identityHashCode` on it twice, return how many DISTINCT hash values you saw
(one — identity is stable).

tests.name: the boxed cache boundary
tests.hint: == on boxed numerics is a latent bug.
